en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural landscape with cultivated fields in the foreground and a village in the distance. The village features a prominent church with a tall spire surrounded by small houses and farm buildings. On the right side is a large barn or farm complex. The bottom margin of the card is blank except for printed red text identifying the location and publisher.
